video_prompt.prompt: Southern European or mixed-ethnicity woman, late 20s to early 30s, warm sun-tanned skin with natural sun pigmentation — irregular melanin clustering across nose bridge and upper cheeks, varying depths some near-invisible, not cosmetic freckles. Medium brown hair pulled into a messy high bun — loose strands falling at temples and nape, natural frizz on top, bun not perfectly round, slight sun-bleached lighter strands visible at crown. Green-hazel eyes with visible iris texture and depth, natural lashes, slight asymmetry between eyes. Visible pores on nose and inner cheeks, natural sebum sheen on T-zone, sun-warmed glow on nose bridge and cheekbones from direct outdoor light, slight redness at nose tip, natural under-eye shadow. Wearing leopard print and tropical floral bikini top with gold ring hardware at center, gold Van Cleef style clover necklace layered, gold clover drop earrings, gold Van Cleef clover bracelet on wrist. She is reclined on a sun lounger with a teal/dark green beach towel draped over it, tropical resort setting — lush palm trees, large tropical leaves, wooden pergola structure behind, bright direct tropical sun overhead. Shot on iPhone front camera, arm-extended selfie angle, slight high angle. Bright tropical midday sun — strong direct light on face and chest, natural sun shadows under nose and chin, warm golden skin tone amplified by direct sunlight. Do not smooth skin. No beauty filter. Preserve exact facial identity, sun pigmentation, jewelry, and bikini throughout entire video.

script.line_2: Look — we're live right now, and they really wanna see you… say hello.

0-2s.action: She is relaxed and reclined, not fixed or posed — head turns slightly to the left off camera, casual and warm. She shifts her body weight naturally on the lounger, one shoulder rolling forward slightly. Her hand drops away from her face completely — resting on her chest or the towel beside her. She calls out with a relaxed half-smile, eyes soft and expectant, glancing off to the side. Natural micro-movements — slight hair movement from breeze, fabric of bikini top shifting with breath.
0-2s.speech_direction: Warm, casual, affectionate — like calling a pet. Slight pause between 'baby' and 'come here'. Not loud — conversational volume, intimate tone. Lips move naturally, jaw relaxed.

2-6s.action: Adult male lion with full thick mane walks slowly into frame from the left side — large, heavy, natural gait, paws landing with weight. Lion approaches her lounger and lowers its large head toward her torso and shoulder area. She reacts with immediate genuine delight — eyes widening, smile breaking naturally, body shifting toward the lion. Her hand reaches out and begins stroking the lion's mane — fingers pressing into the thick fur, hand moving in a slow natural rubbing motion along the side of the mane and behind the ear. Her other arm wraps loosely around the lion's neck. Natural weight transfer — the lion's presence causes the lounger to shift slightly, her body adjusting. Lion's tail moves slowly. Lion exhales — slight nostril flare visible.
2-6s.direction: The woman's reaction must look completely natural and unsurprised — she knows this lion. Not fearful, not performative excitement. The hand rubbing the mane is the most important physical detail — fingers visibly pressing into fur with real contact, not hovering. Her face turns toward the lion briefly then back toward camera.

6-12s.action: She turns her face back toward the camera — now holding the phone up or looking directly at the lens, lion's large head resting against her shoulder or chest, mane filling the left side of frame. Her hand continues slow rhythmic strokes on the lion's mane throughout — never stops. Expression is playful and warm, eyebrows raised slightly, smile natural and asymmetric. Free hand gestures loosely toward the lion on 'you'. At the end of the line she glances at the lion with a fond expression then back to camera. The lion shifts its head slightly — natural animal movement, blinks slowly, nostril flare. Bright sun catches the lion's mane — warm golden tones in the fur. Breeze moves loose strands of her hair.
6-12s.script: Look — we're live right now, and they really wanna see you… say hello.
6-12s.speech_direction: Playful, warm, slightly conspiratorial — like she's showing off her best friend. 'Look' said directly to camera with eyebrow raise. Slight pause before 'say hello', eyes flicking to lion on 'you'. Ends with a soft laugh or smile breaking through on 'say hello'.

lion_direction.breed: Adult male African lion, full thick dark-gold mane, large heavy body, amber eyes
lion_direction.entry: Walks in from left side of frame at 2s — slow natural gait, heavy paw placement, head slightly lowered as it approaches
lion_direction.behaviour: Calm, familiar, affectionate — not aggressive, not performing. Lowers head onto her shoulder/chest. Slow tail movement throughout. One slow blink. Nostril flare on exhale. Minor head shift at 10s — natural animal restlessness not a jump
lion_direction.fur_detail: Thick mane with natural variation in colour — darker at roots, golden-amber at tips, individual strands visible, slight wind movement. Sun catches top of mane — warm specular highlight. Her fingers visibly press into and displace the fur when stroking
lion_direction.scale: Lion's head when lowered is roughly the same width as her torso — the size contrast is part of the visual impact

camera_behavior.movement: Slight natural hand movement throughout — not stabilised. At 6s when she reorients to camera, brief natural camera reframe — arm adjusting position causes 1-2 second slight shake before settling
camera_behavior.framing_0_to_2s: Face and upper chest — loose relaxed framing, head turn visible
camera_behavior.framing_2_to_6s: Camera stays roughly in place as lion enters — lion's head and mane fill left side of frame, her reaction fills right
camera_behavior.framing_6_to_12s: Slightly wider — both her face and lion's head visible in frame together, her hand on mane visible

video_prompt.prompt: Young woman with wavy blonde-to-light-brown balayage hair, fair skin with light natural freckles across nose and cheeks, blue eyes, seated cross-legged in a black-and-grey gaming chair in a bedroom lit by warm golden lamp/sunset light. She is wearing a form-fitting black mini dress and sheer black thigh-high stockings, holding a phone up for a mirror selfie. Clip opens with no helmet and no suit — just the reference outfit. Two snap-transitions follow: the first equips the helmet, the second equips the full plugsuit. Preserve her exact body proportions, seated pose, room, gaming chair, and lighting throughout the entire clip — only the helmet and bodysuit are ever added, nothing else changes. The plugsuit's colorway must match the helmet exactly: aged metallic red-and-silver with chipped, scratched battle-worn paint and a matte metallic sheen — NOT the clean saturated orange/red of the illustrated character sheet, which is used for panel-line shape only.

reference_images.model_reference: Photo 2 — source of identity, body proportions, seated pose, gaming chair, room, and lighting. Held constant, never altered.
reference_images.costume_shape_reference: Photo 1 — official EVA-02 plugsuit character sheet, used ONLY for panel-line shape and cut: fitted bodysuit with black side panels, green centre-chest stripe, white core connector ports, integrated gloves and boots, curved seams matching torso/hip lines. Its bright clean orange colour is NOT used.
reference_images.helmet_and_color_reference: Photo 3 — physical prop build of the helmet: scratched/chipped metallic red-and-silver paint, matte battle-worn finish, dark blue visor. This is the color/material source for BOTH the helmet and the plugsuit — the suit must look like it was cut from the same weathered metallic material as the helmet shell.

0-1s.action: She sits in the gaming chair exactly as in the reference photo — no helmet, no suit, just the dress and stockings, phone held up for the mirror-selfie framing. Natural micro-movements, relaxed posture, casual energy establishing the 'before' state clearly before anything changes.
0-1s.direction: Short and clean — this beat only needs to register 'normal girl, normal fit' before the first snap. Don't let it drag.

1-2s.action: Her free hand snaps once at chest height. On the exact snap frame, a fast 2-3 frame white-orange light bloom sweeps across her head and shoulders. When it clears, the weathered metallic red-and-silver helmet is on her head, visor down, exactly matching Photo 3.
1-2s.direction: First hard cut. Same mechanic as the second transition later — establishes the visual language early so the second snap reads as a continuation, not a new idea. Body, chair, and framing do not move.

2-5s.action: She holds the pose with the helmet on, visor concealing her face. Small chair swivel, subtle head tilt toward the camera, free hand drifts back down near her chest, fingers relaxed and about to snap again. Tension visibly builds toward the second transition.
2-5s.direction: This is the anticipation beat for the costume reveal — treat it like the 'before' half of a TikTok outfit-transition edit, unhurried, confident.

5-6s.action: Second snap of the free hand at chest height. Same 2-3 frame white-orange light bloom sweeps across her full seated body — not a slow dissolve.
5-6s.direction: Hard cut sold by the light flash and a synced snap/whoosh cue. Chair, framing, and lighting must not shift across the cut — only the outfit beneath the neck changes.

6-10s.action: She is now in the complete plugsuit, colour-matched to the helmet's weathered metallic red-and-silver finish, seated in the identical cross-legged pose in the same chair. Helmet is unchanged from the first transition. Camera does a subtle 5-8% push-in for payoff. Free hand returns to hold the phone up, completing the selfie framing. Small confident chair swivel to sell the reveal since her face stays hidden behind the visor. Hold the pose through the outro.
6-10s.direction: Final reveal payoff — suit must read as cut from the same material as the helmet, continuous at the neckline, no visible seam or gap, no color mismatch.

transformation_direction.trigger: Two single finger-snaps of the free hand at chest height, each synced to a sharp audio snap/whoosh — one to equip the helmet (1-2s), one to equip the suit (5-6s)
transformation_direction.mechanic: Hard cut on each snap frame masked by a matching 2-3 frame light bloom overlay — instantaneous both times, not a slow morph or dissolve; identical mechanic repeated so the two beats read as one consistent visual language
transformation_direction.continuity: Seated position, chair, room, lighting, and camera framing are held constant across both cuts — only helmet (after snap 1) and suit (after snap 2) are added, in that order, and never removed once added
transformation_direction.costume_result: Complete plugsuit matching Photo 1's panel-line shape exactly but recoloured to match Photo 3's weathered metallic red-and-silver finish — chipped paint accents, matte metallic sheen, visible panel seams, green chest stripe, connector ports, suit collar meeting the helmet base with no visible gap or colour break
transformation_direction.helmet_state: Appears at the first snap (1-2s) and is unchanged for the rest of the clip — same weathered prop helmet from Photo 3, visor stays down, no removal or redesign at any point

camera_behavior.device: iPhone mirror selfie — matches Photo 2's exact framing and crop (full body to mid-thigh)
camera_behavior.movement: Mostly static with natural handheld micro-shake like a real mirror selfie; subtle push-in only during the 6-10s reveal segment
camera_behavior.framing: Consistent across the whole clip so both snap-cuts read as one continuous shot interrupted only by the flashes

video_prompt.negative_prompt: slow dissolve, blurry transition, morphing face, extra limbs, warped hands, distorted chair, character face visible under visor, helmet removed, helmet redesigned mid-clip, bright saturated orange suit, unweathered clean suit color, suit color mismatched from helmet, flat cel-shaded texture on suit, mismatched lighting between segments, inconsistent room or chair, plastic skin, beauty filter, low-resolution costume texture, anime cel-shading on the live-action suit, wrong stripe colors, missing green chest stripe, watermark, text overlay

lighting.type: warm practical lamp / golden-hour light matching Photo 2, unchanged across both cuts

environment.location: bedroom / gaming setup matching Photo 2's background — desk, chair, soft furnishings
environment.chair: black-and-grey gaming chair from Photo 2, held constant

audio.music: cyberpunk-style synth track, 180 BPM, driving/aggressive energy

audio.snap_cue_2: sharp finger-snap/whoosh synced exactly to the suit flash frame at 5-6s
